content:
samir: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A re: pricing and usage policy. Two recurring asks from sales/support: clear "single-sentence" blurb for credits vs quotas, and a small FAQ with trial numbers + burst behavior. Can we capture here?
jess: Single-sentence canonical: Credits are prepaid consumption units used on Hosted plans; quotas are enforced ceilings (requests/min, tokens/day) applied per org/route/pool; Dedicated = reserved throughput commitments with configurable burst windows.
kai: A couple of edge Qs from Support: 1) Do hosted/trial credits roll over? 2) Are prepaid credits refundable? 3) Can Hosted burst above quotas if infra has slack?
rachel: Answers: 1) Self-serve trial and prepaid credits do not auto-rollover by default. 2) Refunds are not provided under standard self-serve terms; enterprise contracts can contain custom refund/rollover clauses. 3) Hosted supports limited bursts when theres cluster headroom — bursts are bounded by tiered short-window ceilings and safety limits; if headroom is low we throttle or route to smaller compatible models.
samir: Can we add sample numbers for the one-pager? Sales needs concrete examples (clearly labeled as illustrative).
jess: Example (illustrative): Trial org: 200k tokens/day, short burst cap 25k tokens/1min; Growth: 800k tokens/day, burst cap 120k tokens/5min; Enterprise: negotiated. We will mark these as subject to change.
kai: How do priority and throttling behave under global pressure? Do Dedicated customers preempt Hosted?
rachel: Dedicated pools have allocation guarantees and isolation where configured; we avoid preempting in-flight requests. Under severe pressure we favor allocation to reserved pools but generally prefer graceful measures: queueing, fallback models, and rate limiting for Hosted traffic.
ops-bot: infra-note: quota-alerts will fire at 80% and 95% for org token windows; dashboard update scheduled for tomorrow morning.
billing-bot: billing-note: prepaid credits are applied before billed overages; billing disputes/adjustments handled per commercial terms.
samir: Is there an API customers can call to get remaining credits/quotas to show in their own dashboards?
jess: Public endpoint planned: GET /v1/orgs/{org_id}/usage -> returns credit_balance, token_windows, active_rate_limits, per-route quotas. SDK helpers will be added to return a short human summary (eg "12% of trial credits left").
kai: Sales asks for a one-pager + snippet they can paste into demos (API call + example JSON). Can Docs produce that and a short bullet FAQ?
rachel: I will draft the one-pager and a bulleted FAQ. Kai and Jess, please check the sample numbers. Ill include a tiny flowchart of fallback behavior too.
samir: Thanks — can we also include a tiny note about "no in-flight preemption" so customers know prompts won't be killed?
jess: Added that to the draft.
dev-bot: created GH issue #4521 "docs: pricing one-pager + usage API examples" assigned to rachel.
samir: Great, ping here when the PR is up and Sales can add it to the playbook. :thumbsup:
